description: Live aircraft arriving at, leaving or flying over any airport: one row per plane with callsign, route (origin to destination), airline, aircraft type, altitude, speed, distance and ETA. No API key, no login, no proxy: ADSB.lol open data (ODbL) + adsbdb routes. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/live-flights-near-airport.

airports.description: Airport mode: IATA (JFK, LHR, SOF) or ICAO (KJFK, EGLL, LBSF) codes, any country, up to 50. Empty = the example airports JFK, LHR and FRA.

directions.description: Airport mode filter. Any of: arrival, departure, overflight, likely arrival, likely departure, on ground, unknown. Empty = all aircraft.

flights.description: Flight mode: ATC callsigns (BAW123, THY3UG), registrations (N123AB, TC-JVK) or ICAO 24-bit hex codes (4baacb). Up to 100.

includeOnGround.description: Include aircraft that are taxiing or parked at the airport (they report 'ground' instead of an altitude).

includeRoutes.description: Look up each callsign's route and airline (adsbdb.com) and mark the flight as arrival/departure/overflight. Off = positions only (faster).

latitude.description: Area mode: center latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 50.03.

longitude.description: Area mode: center longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 8.57.

maxAltitudeFt.description: Optional: skip airborne aircraft above this altitude, e.g. 15000 to drop high overflights. Empty = no limit.

maxPerAirport.description: Upper limit of rows per airport or point (1-1000). Rows are sorted: arrivals by ETA first, then departures, then the rest by distance.

maxRouteLookups.description: Upper limit of new callsign route lookups per run (0-1000). Routes are cached for 12 hours, so repeated runs are fast.

mode.description: airport = live aircraft within the radius of each airport, with arrival/departure/overflight and ETA; area = live aircraft around any latitude/longitude; flight = find specific aircraft by callsign, registration or ICAO hex code.

radiusNm.description: Airport and area modes: how far around the airport or point to look (1-250 nm). 30 nm covers final approach and initial climb.

name: live_flights_near_airport
title: Live Flights API - Planes Near Any Airport, Routes, ETA
